content_zh:
下水救人对体力消耗太大，她早就累坏了。
东平伯府笼罩在一片静谧的黑暗中，与之隔了两条街的安国公府却人影攒动，灯火通明。
斜靠着床头的安国公夫人卫氏正抓着安国公的手哭得歇斯底里。
安国公面色阴沉，被卫氏哭得心烦意乱，勉强安慰道：“莫哭了，大郎不是赶过去了嘛，三郎不会有事的。”
先前府上因为三郎的失踪闹得人仰马翻，夜里忽闻三郎落水，他只顾得上问一声人有没有事就赶忙命大郎赶过去了，现在竟不知三郎究竟是怎么溺水的。
安国公心中七上八下，这时仆人匆匆进来禀报：“国公爷、夫人，世子带着三公子回来了。”
“快让他们进来！”未等安国公开口，卫氏便猛然坐了起来。
不多时门外响起脚步声，丫鬟挑起珠帘，走进三个人来。
卫氏越过长子季崇礼，一眼就看到了面无血色的三子季崇易，起身扑了过去：“三郎，你这是怎么了？快让娘看看有没有事！”
“娘，我没事。”季崇易露出一抹虚弱的笑容。
“怎么会没事呢？”卫氏抚摸着季崇易的脸颊，泪珠簌簌而落，“头发都是湿的，好端端怎么会落水啊！”
“咳咳。”
咳嗽声响起，卫氏不由看了安国公一眼。
安国公的视线却落在季崇易身后。
离季崇易半丈远立着一位娇小女子，此时正低着头摸着衣摆，难掩不安。
卫氏的脸色当即就变了，声音不由扬起：“她是谁？”
季崇易见状伸手把巧娘拉到身边，直视着卫氏的眼睛：“娘，她就是儿子心悦之人，叫巧娘。”
卫氏脸色不由一僵，盯着巧娘的眼睛深不见底：“原来你就是巧娘啊，先前听说你救了我们三郎，我还没向你道谢呢。”
巧娘惊讶抬头看了卫氏一眼，旋即低下头去，紧张道：“不，不敢当夫人的谢——”
“含芳，带巧娘姑娘下去好好歇息。”卫氏淡淡打断了巧娘的话。

卫氏身边的大丫鬟含芳走到巧娘身旁，笑道：“巧娘姑娘请随婢子来。”
巧娘不由看了季崇易一眼。
季崇易想了想，冲巧娘轻轻点头：“你去歇息吧，明日我就去看你。”
巧娘这才放下心来，跟着丫鬟出去了。
卫氏眼底闪过冷光。
真是一点规矩不懂的野丫头，先不说一个姑娘家与她儿子来往，就说刚才离开时竟不晓得对在场之人行礼，就能看出教养如何了。
“绽蕊，快把姜茶给三公子端上来。”
很快一名与含芳相同装束的丫鬟端着一盏姜茶走上前来。
安国公冷眼看着小儿子把姜茶喝完，这才发问：“到底怎么回事？”
这话却是看着安国公世子季崇礼问的。
季崇礼飞快瞥了季崇易一眼，知道这事瞒也瞒不住，硬着头皮道：“三弟……三弟与那名女子跳湖了……”
“混账！”安国公抬脚踹翻了一把椅子。
季崇易扑通跪了下来。
卫氏嗔怪看了安国公一眼：“老爷发这么大的火干什么？三郎落了水还是赶紧请大夫来瞧瞧，开上几副驱寒的药才好。”
“请大夫做什么？他想死谁能拦得住？”安国公看着跪在地上的季崇易越发气不打一处来，指着他骂道，“小畜生真有本事啊，为了一个女人要死要活的！”
季崇易磕了个头：“父亲，母亲，您二老就成全儿子吧。”
咦，好像歪打正着！
安国公暴跳如雷：“休想，只要我活着你就给我死了这份心，老老实实把东平伯府的四姑娘娶过门来！”
卫氏也不劝了，脸色同样难看。
她原本是瞧不上东平伯府的，当初安国公为了报答东平伯兄弟的救命之恩执意要与他家定下亲事，她还闹了几次。

可是东平伯府再差也比平头百姓强啊。
季崇易直挺挺跪着，语气坚决：“父亲，儿子只喜欢巧娘，不喜欢东平伯府的四姑娘。儿子连见都没见过她，实在没法与她做夫妻！”
“三郎，为父都打听过了，东平伯府的四姑娘在京城贵女中是出名的美人儿。”安国公耐着性子劝道。
“是呀，你们定亲后娘也找机会瞧过了，你父亲没有哄你。”卫氏跟着道。
“在儿子眼里，巧娘就是最美的！”季崇易抬头望着安国公，“父亲，您可以为了报恩与东平伯府结亲，为什么不能理解儿子呢？若是没有巧娘，儿子恐怕早就不在了——”

content_en:
Going into the water to rescue people was too physically demanding and she was already exhausted.
Dongping Bo's Mansion was shrouded in quiet darkness, while Anguo's Mansion, two streets away from it, was full of people and brightly lit.
Mrs. Wei, the wife of Duke An Guo, who was leaning against the bedside, was holding Duke An Guo's hand and crying hysterically.
An Guogong's face was gloomy. He was upset by Wei's crying. He reluctantly comforted him: "Don't cry. Didn't Da Lang rush over? San Lang will be fine."
Previously, there was a huge uproar in the house because of Saburo's disappearance. At night, he suddenly heard that Saburo had fallen into the water. He could only ask if someone was okay and ordered Dalang to rush over. Now he didn't know how Saburo drowned.
Duke An Guo was in a state of confusion when a servant hurriedly came in and reported: "Master and Madam, the prince has returned with the third young master."
"Let them in quickly!" Before Anguo could speak openly, Wei suddenly sat up.
Soon there were footsteps outside the door. The maid lifted the bead curtain and walked in with three people.
Mrs. Wei looked past her eldest son Ji Chongli and saw the bloodless third son Ji Chongyi at a glance. She stood up and rushed towards him: "Sanlang, what's wrong with you? Let me see if everything is okay!"
"Mom, I'm fine." Ji Chongyi showed a weak smile.
"How could it be okay?" Mrs. Wei stroked Ji Chongyi's cheek, tears falling down, "My hair is all wet, how could it fall into the water if it's so good!"
"Ahem."
There was a cough, and Mrs. Wei couldn't help but glance at An Guogong.
Duke An Guo's eyes fell behind Ji Chongyi.
Half a foot away from Ji Chongyi stood a petite woman, lowering her head and touching the hem of her clothes, unable to hide her uneasiness.
Wei's expression immediately changed, and her voice couldn't help but rise: "Who is she?"
When Ji Chongyi saw this, he stretched out his hand to pull Qiao Niang to his side and looked directly into Wei's eyes: "Mom, she is the one that my son likes. She is called Qiao Niang."
Wei's face couldn't help but stiffen, and she stared at Qiao Niang with bottomless eyes: "So you are Qiao Niang. I heard you saved our San Lang before, but I haven't thanked you yet."
Qiao Niang raised her head and glanced at Mrs. Wei in surprise, then lowered her head and said nervously: "No, thank you for not being a wife——"
"Hanfang, take Miss Qiao Niang down and have a good rest." Wei interrupted Qiao Niang's words lightly.
Hanfang, the eldest maid next to Wei, walked to Qiao Niang and said with a smile: "Miss Qiao Niang, please come with me."
Qiao Niang couldn't help but glance at Ji Chongyi.
Ji Chongyi thought for a while and nodded gently to Qiao Niang: "You go and have a rest. I will visit you tomorrow."
Qiao Niang felt relieved and followed the maid out.
A cold light flashed in Wei's eyes.
She is really a wild girl who doesn't understand any rules. Let's not talk about the relationship between a girl and her son, but she didn't know how to salute the people present when she left just now. This shows how well-bred she is.
"Xiangrui, quickly bring the ginger tea to the Third Young Master."
Soon a maid dressed in the same attire as Hanfang came forward with a cup of ginger tea.
Duke An Guo watched his youngest son finish the ginger tea with cold eyes, and then asked: "What's going on?"
This question was asked looking at Ji Chongli, the eldest son of Anguo Gong.
Ji Chongli glanced at Ji Chongyi quickly, knowing that he couldn't hide this matter, so he bit the bullet and said: "Third brother...Third brother jumped into the lake with that woman..."
"Bastard!" Duke An Guo kicked over a chair.
Ji Chongyi knelt down.
Wei Shi glanced at An Guogong angrily: "Why are you so angry? If Sanlang fell into the water, it would be better to ask the doctor to take a look and prescribe some medicine to dispel the cold."
"What are you asking for, doctor? Who can stop him if he wants to die?" An Guogong looked at Ji Chongyi who was kneeling on the ground and became more and more angry. He pointed at him and cursed, "You little beast is really capable. He will live or die for a woman!"
Ji Chongyi kowtowed: "Father, mother, you two elders please help your son."
Hey, it seems like a hit!
An Guogong was furious: "Don't even think about it., As long as I am alive, you will give up your love for me and marry the fourth girl from Dongpingbo's house honestly! "
Wei Shi stopped trying to persuade her, her expression was equally ugly.
She originally looked down upon Uncle Dongping's family. When Duke An Guo insisted on getting married to his family in order to repay Brother Dongping's life-saving grace, she had several troubles.
But no matter how bad Dongping's residence is, it is still better than ordinary people.
Ji Chongyi knelt straight and said firmly: "Father, my son only likes Qiao Niang, and does not like the fourth girl from Dongping's house. My son has never even met her, so he really can’t be married to her! "
"Sanlang, my father has already inquired about it. The fourth girl from Dongping's residence is famously beautiful among the noble ladies in the capital. "An Guogong persuaded patiently.
"Yes, your engaged stepmother also found a chance to see it, but your father didn't coax you. "Wei Shi followed.
"In my son's eyes, Qiao Niang is the most beautiful! "Ji Chongyi looked up at An Guogong and said, "Father, you can marry Dongping Bofu in order to repay your kindness. Why can't you understand your son? If it weren’t for Qiao Niang, my son would probably be gone long ago——”
